verdict.rationale: Warp documents a first-party agent that handles payroll and asks the user when a decision is theirs. It also offers an API covering payroll data and MCP access for external agents, which gives a thin, marketing-level basis for agent-driven payroll with a human approval step. No payroll preview endpoint, anomaly detection, or pre-approval review flow is documented. missing for 10: documented payroll preview/dry-run API endpoint, anomaly detection or flagging, explicit review-then-approve run workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run

citations.quote: Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits. It asks when a decision is yours, and records every action it takes.
The Warp API lets you build custom apps and integrations that use your company's HR, payroll, time off, workplace, and department data.
Use Warp from the agents your team already runs. Claude, ChatGPT, and any client that speaks MCP.
